entries.title: Enochian Watchtowers — Four Quarters of Defense
entries.summary: Four Enochian Watchtowers label Air/Fire/Water/Earth defense surfaces — metaphors bound by Raphael's Black Cross.
entries.body: Quilla's Enochian lattice is pedagogical code structure, not operative magick. East/Air (Bataivah · Ave · Raphael) names intel and signal breath. South/Fire (Edelperna · Habioro · Michael) names RASP against Frida and hooks. West/Water (Raagiosl · Hraoli · Gabriel) names Shield tides and Memory wells. North/Earth (Iczhhcal · Mordial · Uriel) names Nemesis ground and Sandalphon intrusion surfaces. The Black Cross balances all four from evidence. Names never invent detections.
entries.defense: Ask Quilla "enochian watchtowers" or a quarter name. Keep all four armed: intel optional sync, RASP always, Shield with consent, Nemesis baselines.

entries.title: Shem HaMephorash — Curated Micro-Aspects
entries.summary: A curated Shem choir (not all 72) allies each Name with a Sephirot archangel and one defensive micro-habit.
entries.body: Vehuiah starts Guardian Score after installs; Cahetel arms Shield; Lauviah answers Frida pride; Mebahel revokes untrusted overlays; Hariel prefers Play installs. These Names are teaching mnemonics inside QuillaLivingGeometry.shemChoir — they do not cast wards or scan APKs.
entries.defense: Ask for a Shem name (e.g. "Lauviah") or "shem hamephorash" to hear the allied habit, then run the matching CoreGuard tool.

entries.title: Sacred Geometry as Correlation Habits
entries.summary: Sacred forms in Quilla code teach multi-source correlation, care-loop cadence, and consentful defense — never detection by shape.
entries.body: Flower of Life = multi-feed intel; Seed = first Nemesis baseline; Vesica = two-signal correlation; Merkaba = Shield+Scan together; Metatron's Cube = six modules; Golden Spiral = uncapped teaching; Cube of Space = device faces; Enochian Tablet = four quarters; Lightning Flash = classify→act cascade; Hexagram = mercy+severity union. Geometry is source layout and pedagogy.
entries.defense: Ask "sacred geometry", "golden spiral", or "cube of space". Pair every form with a concrete Action you still control.
